decisions: Native PPE and NSS both reach the1G wired endpoint ceiling. Their maximum capacities cannot be inferred from these rates.
Use matched offered-load UDP CPU/loss and per-core load to assess acceleration benefit. TCP rates alone mix endpoint, RF and CPU limits.
limits: Tests use sequential runs with schedutil CPU frequency and uncontrolled RF conditions. No energy measurement or statistical confidence interval is claimed.

ath11k source and original module .text match the previous checkpoint. This rules out an ath11k code delta as the direct rebase change, but does not exclude a latent shared-driver bug, reset/hardware issue or lifecycle interaction.

Patch959 is validated by source-derived helper tests and ordinary traffic/lifecycle tests. On-air802.11 fragmentation remains unqualified; no all-races-eliminated or long-term stability claim is made.
